source_clause: CR12.) Alternative fan speed pop up: in these variants, when the fan speed pop up is triggered by the interaction with hard controls, the pop up will show additional information on the Rear Climate fan speed. The pop up will show the front fan speed status (level number, AUTO, OFF) and the Rear fan status (level number, AUTO, OFF). The pop up will be touch interactive: by pressing on the Front Fan area, the user will be redirected to the Front climate tab; by pressing on the Rear fan area, the user will be redirected to the Rear climate tab. See «HVAC Popups» chapter and C1.) and C2.) requirements for further information on pop ups logics.
reasoning: **本節依 R-C42 解封**（64 §1）：其停下之唯一依據為「該配置軸未登記」，而條文自帶適用條件 —— 其適用範圍由 `9.1`（CR11）「**On some vehicles (See CFTS043 for details), there are additional Rear Climate controls and shortcuts**」界定，本節以「in these variants」回指之（跨節取據 R-C29）。驗證目標：CR12 定出替代式風速 popup 之內容與其觸控導向，兩個 037 leaf 對應之。關鍵情境條件：上述變體條件（**待軸化候選；DR #41 之問句改為「該變體涵蓋哪些車輛」而非「可否生成」**）；依 **R-C34** 三軸暴露 → 補。為什麼這樣切：popup 之內容（`040-01`）與其互動（`040-02`）失效形態不同；**「See «HVAC Popups» chapter and C1./C2. requirements」為對本 spec 他節之委派**，其 popup 之一般邏輯不在本節驗（§8.2.1，此即本節刻意略過者）。

tcs.tc_title: The alternative fan pop-up shows front and rear fan status
tcs.test_item: The system shall show the front fan speed status (level number, AUTO, OFF) and the Rear fan status (level number, AUTO, OFF) in the fan speed pop up
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-verbatim] On some vehicles (See CFTS043 for details), there are additional Rear Climate controls and shortcuts (9.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Trigger the fan speed pop up using the hard controls
2. Read the pop up
tcs.expected_result:
1. The fan speed pop up is displayed
2. The pop up shows the front fan status and the rear fan status
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
